title: introduce-latency-spectra-and-contextual-cost-calibrator
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: We have strong token-level cost and latency metrics, but long-tail bursts and allocation-driven skew remain hard to attribute. This PR introduces two complementary observability primitives: (1) latency spectra — a multi-scale decomposition that captures per-invocation latency energy across ordered pipeline phases (network, scheduling, kernel, kv-warmup, generation) and produces compact spectral sketches suitable for low-cardinality rollups; and (2) contextual cost calibrator — a runtime-side annotator that tags token cost with allocator and lane metadata (GPU slot, prefetch bucket, quantization profile) and emits calibrated cost slices for accurate per-tenant chargebacks and alerting.

review_comments: Ethan Cho (reviewer): Nice approach — can you clarify how spectra handles late-arriving spans from KV cache hydration? I worry about double-counting in rollups.

Priya Menon (author): Spectra contains a 'late_energy' bucket that is emitted only if the late span does not match an existing invocation_id within the sampling window. The rollup job applies a de-duplication join keyed by invocation fingerprint to avoid double-counts. Added notes to docs.
Marina Volkova (reviewer): The allocator labels look high-cardinality (gpu_slot + prefetch_bucket + qprofile). We should provide an aggregated view for SLO dashboards.

Priya Menon (author): Agreed — added a normalized label 'alloc_cluster' that buckets low-volume combinations into 'other' at emitter time and added a fallback sampling path that drops fine-grained alloc tags for low-tier customers. See runtime/annotators/cost_calibrator.go changes.
Samir Patel (reviewer): CI failed on flaky test test_spectra_emission; looks timing-sensitive. Please make integration test resilient.
Priya Menon (author): Reworked test to use deterministic synthetic runner with fixed timestamps and added lightweight retry; CI green locally and on rerun.
ci_checks: bench: warn (spectra emitter microbench added, no regressions >5%)
release_notes: Add latency spectra: a multi-scale spectral decomposition of invocation latency producing compact rollups for long-tail analysis.
Add contextual cost calibrator: runtime annotator that tags and calibrates per-token cost by allocator and quantization profile for accurate tenant accounting.
New dashboard panels and alert rules for spectra-based anomalies and allocator-aware cost spikes.
No breaking changes to public API; opt-in feature behind feature flag `observability.latency_spectra` for gradual rollout.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: enable for 5% of hostnames for 48h, validate cost drift against billing summary, enlarge to 25% then 100%. Backout: disable feature flag and rely on rollup de-dupe to reconcile partial samples.
testing_notes: Unit coverage added for spectra decomposition. Integration uses synthetic_spectra_runner to produce deterministic hotpath and coldpath invocations. Bench run included to ensure emitter <2% p95 latency overhead. Manual QA: validated dashboard queries and alerts in staging and replayed 24h of production traces to check join heuristics.
docs_summary: docs/observability/latency-spectra.md describes algorithm, rollup schema, and runbook. Added observability playbook steps for triaging allocator-correlated spikes and instructions to backfill calibrated slices for billing reconciliation.
notes_for_oncall: New alerts tuned with hysteresis: spectra_anomaly will open when spectral energy in generation band increases >30% vs baseline for 10m and calibrated-cost-spike will trigger when allocator-tagged cost increases across >5% of tenants. If noisy, increase alert quiet window or disable fine-grained alloc labels via feature flag.
